title: La Siesta de los Peces
techniques: opaque silhouettes with hard shade side
statement: I painted the shade instead of the objects: every white in the picture is either sunlit-near-white or violet-white, and the whole composition rests on the diagonal where the awning's shadow cuts the foreground. The one strong dark sits in the bottom-right corner and the doorway, so the light has something to be light against. The people are backs and shadowed faces at work, never looking at us.
fix_pass: post-CRITIQUE-A: near figure made opaque and anchored, shade rebuilt as three bounced lights, sun glare clipped through the tarp
